findings.text: `source < existing_source` compares `ParameterSource` members. If that is a plain `enum.Enum`, `<` raises `TypeError`. It fires whenever a second option writes a parameter name that already has a source, e.g. a feature-switch group like `--a/--b` with `flag_value` sharing one name. Even with an ordered enum, the declaration order (COMMANDLINE, ENVIRONMENT, DEFAULT, DEFAULT_MAP, PROMPT) would not give the intended explicitness ranking. For example, PROMPT would rank as less explicit than DEFAULT.

When the slot's earlier value is UNSET, `slot_empty` makes a later option win, even if it only supplied a DEFAULT and the earlier option came from the command line. The `elif existing_source is None` branch is also skipped when the source was already set. As a result, the source can be overwritten, or can disagree with the stored value, when `expose_value=False` options share a name.

0.reason: ParameterSource is an IntEnum in click, so comparison is valid and ordered by declaration.

1.reason: The slot_empty condition lets a later DEFAULT source overwrite an earlier COMMANDLINE source when expose_value=False, causing source/value disagreement.
